components.label: ZTF Object API
components.description: Queries metadata for ZTF alert objects (name, coordinates, first/last detection).

components.label: ZTF Lightcurve API
components.description: Returns detections and non-detections (the photometric light curve) for a ZTF object.

components.label: ZTF Magstats API
components.description: Per-band magnitude statistics (min, max, mean) for a ZTF object.

components.label: ZTF Probabilities API
components.description: Classifier probabilities (e.g. SN, AGN, variable star) for a ZTF object.

components.label: ZTF Features API
components.description: Light-curve features used as input to ALeRCE classifiers.

components.label: ZTF Classifiers API
components.description: Lists the available ZTF classifiers and their output classes.

components.label: ZTF Forced Photometry API
components.description: Forced-photometry light curves (flux measured at a fixed position) for ZTF objects.

components.label: Multi-survey Object API
components.description: Object metadata API for the multi-survey (LSST-era) backend.

components.label: Multi-survey Lightcurve API
components.description: Light-curve API for the multi-survey (LSST-era) backend.

components.label: Multi-survey Probability API
components.description: Classifier probabilities API for the multi-survey (LSST-era) backend.

components.label: Multi-survey Stamps API
components.description: Image stamps (science, reference, difference) for multi-survey objects.

components.label: ZTF Stamps API
components.description: Image stamps (science, reference, difference) for ZTF alerts.

components.label: Crossmatch API
components.description: Cone-search crossmatch against external catalogs (Gaia, AllWISE, etc.).

components.label: ALeRCE Explorer
components.description: Web interface for searching, visualizing, and inspecting ALeRCE alert objects.

components.label: Python Client Docs
components.description: Documentation for the alerce-client Python library on Read the Docs.
